# The C ABI's SIGNATURES: return type, name, parameter TYPES (no parameter names).
#
# Generated by `python tools/check_bindings.py --emit-signatures`; compared on every run.
# A parameter NAME is deliberately absent: renaming one is invisible to a caller. A type, an
# order or a count is not, and changing one fails the gate -- which is the point, because the
# symbol list next door only freezes names.
#
const char* cppp2_code_text(int32_t)
const char* cppp2_dict_dir_candidate()
const char* cppp2_version()
cppp2_engine* cppp2_open(const cppp2_registry*, const char*, const char*, cppp2_error*)
int32_t cppp2_apply_tone_sandhi(const cppp2_engine*, cppp2_result*, const cppp2_tone_sandhi_opts*, size_t*)
int32_t cppp2_dialect_ids(const cppp2_registry*, char***, size_t*)
int32_t cppp2_is_polyphonic(const cppp2_engine*, const char*, int32_t*)
int32_t cppp2_load_traditional_dict(cppp2_engine*, const char*, int32_t)
int32_t cppp2_load_traditional_dict_ex(cppp2_engine*, const char*, int32_t, cppp2_error*)
int32_t cppp2_load_user_dict(cppp2_engine*, const char*, int32_t)
int32_t cppp2_load_user_dict_ex(cppp2_engine*, const char*, int32_t, cppp2_error*)
int32_t cppp2_query(const cppp2_engine*, const char*, const cppp2_query_opts*, cppp2_result**)
int32_t cppp2_readings(const cppp2_engine*, const char*, const cppp2_query_opts*, char***, size_t*)
int32_t cppp2_render_syllable(const cppp2_engine*, const cppp2_syllable*, const cppp2_query_opts*, char**)
int32_t cppp2_style_list(const cppp2_engine*, cppp2_style**, size_t*)
int32_t cppp2_to_simplified(const cppp2_engine*, const char*, char**)
int32_t cppp2_tone_convert(const cppp2_engine*, const char*, int32_t, char**)
void cppp2_destroy(cppp2_engine*)
void cppp2_query_opts_init(cppp2_query_opts*)
void cppp2_result_free(cppp2_result*)
void cppp2_string_free(char*)
void cppp2_string_list_free(char**, size_t)
void cppp2_style_list_free(cppp2_style*, size_t)
